statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail at 20% sits in the watch band and below the blocking threshold, while Stress remains high on the oil and duration backdrop.
recommendation: A narrow evidence-based danger window is flagged around the 13:30Z US cash open and the first cash hour, where an opening imbalance that holds without retracement would be the amplifying evidence. Outside that window the current evidence is consistent with intact mean reversion rather than a persistent one-way path.
headline: Nasdaq-100 steady into the US open as futures pare losses; oil near four-month highs and a 5% 10-year keep Stress high ahead of the Fed
body: NQ futures are near 29,431, down 0.06%, after paring an earlier decline of roughly 90 points, and VIX near 17.0 sits at the low of its 17.02-18.03 daily range. The Nasdaq-100 cash index closed Sep 14 at 29,127.16, down 0.82%, but well off its 28,867.67 session low, so meaningful retracement has been occurring rather than failing. The macro backdrop is genuinely stressed: the 10-year yield is near 4.96% after briefly topping 5% on Sep 14 for the first time since 2023, the 30-year touched 5.38%, and WTI near $102 with Brent near $106 reflects the Saudi East-West pipeline outage that places roughly 4% of global supply at risk. Commentary on AI safety is weighing on AI-linked names, and delayed latest-session context shows split internals, with semiconductors firm against softer software and most megacaps. That combination of conflicting internals, high event importance and an unresolved supply shock raises Stress rather than Tail, because none of it is yet evidence of a price path that denies retracement. Tail is held at 20% in the watch band, with the narrow danger window limited to the cash-open transition. The Fed decision at 18:00Z on Sep 16 and the Chair press conference at 18:30Z fall beyond this 24-hour horizon and are carried as calendar checkpoints.

sources.title: Federal Reserve H.15 Selected Interest Rates

lookbackSummary: All 24 preceding clock hours carry a published Claude assessment. Tail oscillated between 14% and 26% without settling above the blocking threshold: it printed 26% at 13:00Z on Sep 14 and 25% at 08:00Z today on two brief trend-down phases, and fell to 14-16% through the overnight hours. Stress declined steadily from the high 70s on Sep 14 into the mid 60s overnight before rebuilding into the low 70s this morning as the oil and yield backdrop reasserted. The repeated failure of trend-down phases to persist is itself evidence that retracement has been available.
outlookSummary: The horizon runs from the current pre-open hour to 11:00Z on Sep 16 and therefore ends before the Fed decision. Tail is modeled highest around the 13:30Z cash open and the first cash hour, easing through midday as two-way discovery is assumed to re-establish, rising again modestly into the power hour and cash close on hedging and settlement flow, then falling to its lowest levels overnight. It drifts back toward the watch band across the European morning of Sep 16 as the pre-Fed session builds. Stress stays high or elevated throughout because the oil supply shock and the 5% long end are unresolved, and Confidence decays with distance from the evidence cutoff.

forecast.analysis: Power hour. The final cash hour before a Fed decision day can carry concentrated hedging and index rebalancing flow, a recognised source of one-way extension. Tail is modeled back into the watch band as a conditional allowance for that flow, not because such structure is present now.
